what: F4 PARTIAL RUN: lead-trader file: the same fill listed twice (a relay retry)
expected: the fill listed once (a repeated relay event id is one trade), or the lead-trader file read as unavailable
shown: the same ETH long open listed twice in the Lead trader panel, as two trades
cause: index.html tradesProblems (~l.530-538) checks shape, newest-first and future times only; the schema's trades item has no id, so a repeated event passes. The relay (cloudflare/ctzb-trades-worker.js appendEvents ~l.318-326) dedupes against a KV read that is eventually consistent (cron every minute), so a stale read can append an event twice. Real life: KV staleness + 1-minute cron.
